terms: fal.ai model output; speridlabs/idol/max lists commercial use as supported. Generated for this project; no third-party likeness, brand or logo requested.

steps.prompt: A small zippy round sky-blue cartoon songbird toy figure standing on two small orange feet, round body with a white belly patch, short pointed yellow-orange beak, big round white eyes with teal irises and cheeky eyebrows, a perky three-feather bright yellow crest on the head, smooth rounded sides with NO wings at all, no arms, nothing on the sides of the body. Photograph of a real hand-painted wooden toy: carved and lathe-turned hardwood with smooth satin enamel paint, visible wood grain and soft brush strokes, chunky rounded toy proportions, tilt-shift macro product photography, soft warm daylight. Single isolated object, the entire object in frame with margin, centered, three-quarter front view from slightly above, even soft studio lighting, no cast shadow, plain light-grey seamless background. No text, no logos, no lettering, no numbers, no brand marks, no emblems anywhere on the object.
